'''Prashee''' was an [[Ubdurian]] [[Gender|male]] and the identical brother of [[Cratinus]]. The two used their identical appearances to swap identities during profitable scams.<ref name="TFAVD" /> In [[34 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 BBY]].</ref> both brothers were present in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]]. As the pair laughed together at a table, the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] entered with the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[Astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. Not long after the four newcomers arrived, many of the patrons in the castle rushed outside to witness the [[First Order]] [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroying]] the [[Hosnian system]] with their [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. Kanata's castle was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the First Order.<ref name="TFA" /> Both Prashee and his brother were [[Gambling|gamblers]]<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> fond of games of chance. Prashee wore a metal cap and an [[Ubdurian traveling smock]] which matched his brothers.<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ubdurian_concept_art.png|thumb|Concept art of Prashee|left|284x284px]]
Prashee first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']],<ref name="TFA" /> which was released in North America on [[December 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-vii-to-open-december-18-2015|text=Star Wars: Episode VII to Open December 18, 2015}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[Tom Bell]],<ref name="Dee Tails interview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/star-wars-anthology/rogue-one/dee-tails-k-ohn|text=Dee Tails (K-OHN)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://www.starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|archivedate=20171209201513|nolive=1}}</ref> who was credited as a creature and droid puppeteer. He was not identified in the film,<ref name="TFA" /> but was named in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> and released the same day as the film.<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref> Parshee was originally created as the only Ubdurian character before it was decided that he needed a companion who would be portrayed by [[Dee Tails]].<ref name="Dee Tails interview" />
